items.text: Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf, Q) will play vs Raiders. Feeling better Saturday; 'as long as no setbacks, feel good about available to play.'
items.implication: Strong WR1 play if active; monitor final inactives ~90 min pre-kick.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected if clears; Davante Adams already OUT boosts him.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad, Q after missing 3) unlikely to play today vs Dolphins. May workout but not full participant yet; bit early.
items.implication: Sit Hall; Braelon Allen elevated to lead role/RB1 upside in good matchup.

items.text: Lamar Jackson downgraded to OUT for Sunday vs Bengals with high ankle sprain; third straight miss. Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain; ruled out Saturday.
items.implication: Huntley start; Ravens pass game downgrade, Zay Flowers/Mark Andrews volume may shift under backup QB.
items.opportunity: Huntley rushing/ dual-threat limited vs Lamar; check Ravens skill usage.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected to resume role as Giants lead back vs Texans. JJ McCarthy long leash.
items.implication: Volume play despite tough matchup; Berry hated the spot.

items.text: Saquon Barkley questionable but expected to play MNF vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Start if active; strong matchup vs DAL for RBs.

items.text: Packers activated Josh Jacobs; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.implication: Jacobs returns to lead RB role; monitor snap share post-layoff.

items.text: Eagles ruled out DeVonta Smith (and Dontayvion Wicks) for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.implication: AJ Brown/Goedert/other WRs target boost; reverse any prior Smith love.
items.opportunity: Brown usage spike in two-WR set.

items.text: Lamar (ankle), Puka (calf), Breece (quad) statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky important scratches: Brian Robinson, Jahwar Jordan, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka.
items.why: DFS leverage on uncertainty; missed scratches impact.
items.implication: Early news priority; fade if OUT, pivot beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Implied opps from scratches (e.g. more work for teammates).

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries OUT dump: Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson (plus others).
items.implication: Direct sit; beneficiaries in respective backfields/WR rooms (e.g. more Bijan if BRob ATL-related, CMC/others SF, Worthy/KC, etc.).
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups/handcuffs; SF WR outs boost CMC slot potential.

items.text: ETR INs: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison, TJ Hockenson, AD Mitchell, Caleb Douglas, Rashod Bateman, Sean Tucker (plus Qs like Puka/Breece/Lamar initially).
items.implication: Return to roles; Judkins/Addison immediate fantasy relevant.

items.text: Rarely buy RB-as-WR statements but tempted by CMC lining up more in slot amid 49ers dire WR injuries (Evans/Deebo OUT) and Kaelon Black presence. CMC smiled at question.
items.why: WR outs create opportunity; coach/player comments.
items.implication: Potential routes/target boost beyond usual RB work.
items.opportunity: Slot snaps, routes, targets in two-minute/red-zone.

items.text: Rico Dowdle (and DeShon Elliott) both up for Steelers (inactives context).
items.implication: Available for snaps in PIT backfield.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield returns (from Q).
items.implication: Full Bucs offense; Egbuka OUT already noted.

items.text: Lamar Jackson was close to playing this week, should next week.
By end of year Jonah Coleman will be Broncos RB you wish you had; roster in 100% of leagues. Activated/expected.
items.why: Prior production + Dobbins/Harvey inefficiency; IR return.

items.text: Berry LOVES A.J. Brown @ CHI (usage/matchup); Bears good for yardage.
items.why: Back in real role + favorable matchup.
items.implication: Strong WR start; further boosted by DeVonta OUT.

items.text: Berry LOVES Tucker Kraft @ DET (TE buffet), Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads/friendly matchups.
items.why: Volume + defenses carved by RBs/TEs (Lions TE TDs).

items.text: Berry HATES Josh Jacobs @ DET (post-layoff workload Q), Rome Odunze vs NE (shadow), Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low scoring), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough D).
items.implication: Fade/sit; Jacobs still expected active but cautious.
items.conflict: Jacobs activation positive but Berry workload dissent.
